◆ Excursion Mode ◆
● Enter Domains of Excursion to experience different stories or challenges. You will receive corresponding rewards upon completion.
● Team Lineup cannot be changed in the Excursion Mode, and cannot teleport to other areas.
● Sustenance Anchors inside Domains of Excursion can regenerate character health, but cannot teleport Trailblazers.
● Certain Warring Expedition stages contain multiple difficulty levels. More difficult levels will be unlocked when easier levels have been completed.

◆ Challenge Goal ◆
● Warring Expedition contains extra challenge goals. Complete these to obtain bonus rewards.
● Each challenge goal can only be completed once. However, you may challenge Warring Expedition stages multiple times to complete different challenge goals.

◆ Leaving Midway ◆
● When exiting an Excursion Mode stage without completing it, you may quit completely or save your progress and leave temporarily.
● The next time you enter the same Excursion Mode stage, you can choose to continue from where you left off or restart the challenge from the beginning.
● After entering the Excursion Mode stage, the previous challenge's progress will be automatically overwritten.
● Each Domain of Excursion can retain one copy of your challenge progress, but when the total number of saved challenge progress exceeds the limit, the oldest one will be deleted according to the order of recency.
